mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM houseinfos hi LEFT JOIN dongcodes dc ON dc.dong_code = CONCAT(hi.sgg_cd, hi.umd_cd) WHERE hi.apt_seq = #{aptSeq}

choose.otherwise: SELECT CAST(hd.no AS CHAR) AS id, hd.apt_seq, 'apt' AS housing_type, 'deal' AS contract_type, COALESCE(hi.apt_nm, '') AS name, COALESCE(hi.umd_nm, '') AS dong, COALESCE(hi.umd_nm, '') AS emd, COALESCE(hi.jibun, '') AS lot, COALESCE(hi.sgg_cd, '') AS region_code, CAST(REPLACE(COALESCE(hd.deal_amount, '0'), ',', '') AS UNSIGNED) AS amount, 0 AS deposit, 0 AS monthly_rent, hd.exclu_use_ar AS area, CAST(REPLACE(COALESCE(hd.floor, '0'), ',', '') AS SIGNED) AS floor, CASE WHEN hd.deal_year > 0 AND hd.deal_month > 0 AND hd.deal_day > 0 THEN DATE_FORMAT(STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(hd.deal_year, LPAD(hd.deal_month, 2, '0'), LPAD(hd.deal_day, 2, '0')), '%Y%m%d'), '%Y-%m-%d') ELSE '' END AS date, CASE WHEN hd.deal_year > 0 AND hd.deal_month > 0 THEN CONCAT(hd.deal_year, LPAD(hd.deal_month, 2, '0')) ELSE '' END AS deal_ymd FROM housedeals hd JOIN houseinfos hi ON hd.apt_seq = hi.apt_seq WHERE hd.apt_seq = #{aptSeq} ORDER BY hd.deal_year DESC, hd.deal_month DESC, hd.deal_day DESC, hd.no DESC LIMIT #{limit}
